device.tuner: probably a Silicon Labs Si2144 option: the image's only tuner-name string is "Si2144", and at start (4 M instructions in) the application reads a single status byte at I2C 0x60 over and over (447 reads in 300 M instructions, no write) -- a Silicon Labs tuner's clear-to-send poll, which a chip answering zeros never satisfies; the box's own 2015 firmware (dumps/STRONG PRIMA VIII/) drives an MxL603 family chip at the same address
device.flash: 4 MB SPI (the box of dumps/STRONG PRIMA VIII/)

image.layout: a complete 4 MB flash image with the M3801 chunk chain: the bootloader chunk at 0 (1.0.0, 2009-06-18, next chunk at 0x01FE00) like the box's flash dump, newer main code, no user database

source.note: Not recorded: Strong's firmware update for the Prima VIII, the "update v1.0.6" the owner of dumps/STRONG PRIMA VIII/ says he downloaded (see that dump).  Added to this repository on 2026-01-20 ("Create SRT_Prima_VIII_V1.0.6_20160114.abs") without a note of where it was downloaded from.

simulator.note: run_dump_Prima_to_check_program.py, run_dump_Prima_to_print_success.py and run_dump_Prima_to_main_app.py boot it through the bootloader ("bl_flash_init!", "bl_verify_sw", "check_program!", "success!") into the main application; no screen regression yet.

desc: Despite the .abs name it is a complete 4 MB flash image.
